subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: What privacy and exposure contract should inbound WhatsApp call events use before they become visible to agents or plugin hooks?
rationale: The listener gap is source-proven, but default-off behavior, metadata retention, access-control filtering, and agent/plugin visibility are product and security boundary choices.

options.title: Default-off sanitized plugin path
options.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned opt-in listener that exposes only filtered call activity metadata after existing account and sender checks.

options.title: Plugin hook only
options.body: Expose call events only through a documented plugin hook and defer agent session/tool behavior to a later decision.

options.title: Defer inbound calls
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers decide WhatsApp call metadata is worth the privacy and verification cost.

recommendation.title: Default-off sanitized plugin path
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned opt-in listener that exposes only filtered call activity metadata after existing account and sender checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He recently owned the related WhatsApp call feature and already scoped this request with product/security boundaries.
